page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with no marginal notes. Running head at the top, page number at the head, catchword at the right below the last line.

main_text.p: cor,aut deniq; iecur,sed unumquodq; qua piam uenenata qualitate infici certisimo sunt argumeto.Propterea principale auxi-lium sit,prius uentre repurgato, & sanguine misso cucurbita satis amplam superimponere,scalpellaq; cute circumcidere: deinde eandem cucurbitam rursum superimponere,ut eliciat uirus. Atuerò qui in hoc affectu cataplasmate discutiente utuntur, aegrotantis uitae perperam consulunt, authore Hippocrate. Venenum enim, quod fagax Natura sponte in emissorium expulit,ad interiora & praecordia isti infipientes intromittunt.Idcirco qui hęc praeuidet bubonibus superimponit quę erodunt,ac pustulas excitant, ut à praecordijs uirus auertatur,attrahaturq; ad locum,ubi natura ualida sponte ducit. Quapropter si caput immoderato somno, aut nocturnis uigilijs opprimi cernatur: uel si alia cerebri male affecti signa apparuerint, ut dolor capitis, aut uertigo,aut delirium, uel aurium murmur, uel faciei rubor cum temporum pulsatione,& urina valde perspicua,in qua sedimentum in sublime tendere apparet,uel alia his similia, tunc circa caput abscessum futurum nobis significabitur. Propterea tu

page.notes: Uncertain readings: "sanguine" (the word after "& " is partly unclear, read as sanguine from context, but the printed form may differ); "certisimo" and "argumeto" are kept as printed; "Atuerò" has a grave accent that may be a printer's mark. Long s is rendered as s throughout (printed as f in places, e.g. "fed", "fcalpellaq", "fit"). The catchword "ad sca-" is partly unclear; the first letter may be f in print.
